purpose: Teach: 防護/寄生虫/万引き/罵倒/国策/保釈/喚問/殺傷

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、現場の防護用品を充実させろ
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Clean diction. No warmth — instructions delivered like facts. Direct eye contact. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外食品の寄生虫対策を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll reinforce our protocols for parasitic contamination in overseas food imports.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Note-taking rhythm beneath the words. Professional confidence without pushback. Slight nod of commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 店舗の万引き対策を強化しろ
lines.en: Tighten anti-theft measures at all storefronts.
lines.style: Sharp, definitive. Each word lands with equal weight. No elaboration — the instruction is complete as stated. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。SNS罵倒への対応窓口を設置しました
lines.en: Understood. We've already established a response channel for social media incidents.
lines.style: Calm report of action already taken. Steady voice, no urgency — this was handled. Pride in execution without self-congratulation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、国策プロジェクトへの参画を検討しろ
lines.en: Consider our participation in the government's strategic initiatives.
lines.style: Lower pitch on the opening. Deliberate pacing — this is a weightier directive. Slight pause after 'initiatives.' Testing Kenji's readiness to handle something larger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑社員の保釈中の処遇を慎重に判断します
lines.en: Understood. We're handling the suspended employee's situation with appropriate caution.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. No defensiveness, but care in word choice. Acknowledging the stakes without dramatizing. Voice stays level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、国会喚問への対応を準備しろ
lines.en: Prepare our response protocol for potential Diet testimony.
lines.style: Lowest register yet. Slow, deliberate delivery. The weight of institutional risk in every syllable. This is not a suggestion — it's an existential briefing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の殺傷事件防止のセキュリティを徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We're implementing comprehensive security measures to prevent any incident involving our staff.
lines.style: Final affirmation, voice steady but heavy. No hesitation — absorbing the full weight of what's been asked. The close of a serious conversation.
